# Quaternius character sample assets

Author: Quaternius. Pack: Zombie Apocalypse Kit (March 2024).
Official source/license declaration: https://quaternius.com/packs/zombieapocalypsekit.html
License: CC0 1.0, https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

Downloaded from the public glTF mirror https://github.com/agentkaerf/FreeModels
because the author's Google Drive download was unreachable from this environment.
Paths are under `Zombie Apocalypse Kit - March 2024/Characters/glTF`.
Git blob IDs (original files, embedded textures/buffers intact):

- Zombie_Basic.gltf: 5c108264ed01bc5bf9edad604c5e172694fda9a7
- Zombie_Chubby.gltf: 988f9f086d7ee55f5bca70a21a9ca52761225ae0
- Characters_Shaun.gltf: f3ef082ff52c5dfe896129e234bca8db343a6d13
- Weapons/glTF/Rifle.gltf: 82ed95f848b903514fc7dd8dff9bf4cfbab0d321

The supplied License.txt text is preserved (line endings/whitespace normalized); it has a generic/different pack heading. The official
pack page explicitly confirms CC0 for this Zombie Apocalypse Kit.

The human is a provisional modern survivor with a rifle, not final historical Shenji art.
Our editor bake replaces the modern rifle mesh with an original wood-stock/long-barrel matchlock
silhouette (including a match holder), samples idle/run/attack/death meshes and adds a
small visual recoil to Idle_Gun (the pack does not contain a dedicated firing clip).
Source skeletons/animations remain here for later Animator or GPU-skinning workflows.
Regenerable baked assets live in ignored `Assets/_Game/Resources/CharacterGenerated`.
